# E Bikes for Sale

> Australian online electric bike retailer. Electric mountain, commuter, step-through, folding, cargo and fat tyre e-bikes, trikes, scooters, batteries and accessories, with free delivery across Australia and a 2-year warranty.

Customers save 10% when paying by bank transfer, Osko or crypto. Orders are placed online and confirmed by email from sales@ebikesale.com.au.

## Shop

- [All electric bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop): full range with filters for brand, motor, frame, tyres and price
- [Electric mountain bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/electric-mountain-bikes): hardtail and full-suspension eMTBs
- [Electric commuter bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/electric-commuter-bikes): city and step-through e-bikes
- [Folding electric bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/folding-electric-bikes): compact foldable e-bikes
- [Electric cargo bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/electric-cargo-bikes): family and cargo e-bikes
- [Electric trikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/electric-trikes): three-wheel e-bikes for adults
- [Cheap electric bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/cheap-electric-bikes): affordable e-bikes under $2,000
- [Fat tyre electric bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/fat-tyre-electric-bikes): wide-tyre e-bikes
- [Trek electric bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/trek-electric-bikes): Rail, Marlin+, Dual Sport+ and Allant+
- [SmartMotion e-bikes](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/smartmotion-electric-bikes): city and trail e-bikes
- [Ebike batteries and chargers](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/ebike-batteries-chargers): range extenders and chargers
- [E-bike parts and accessories](https://ebikesale.com.au/shop/ebike-parts-accessories): batteries, helmets and gear
